project_type: Next.js 15 App Router + TypeScript, Neon Postgres serverless, Drizzle ORM, Tailwind CSS, Zod validation, Vitest unit tests
build_system: pnpm (v9.1.0 available at /opt/homebrew/bin/pnpm). Node v26.5.0. Use pnpm for all installs and scripts. Standard Next.js scripts: dev, build, start, lint. Custom scripts: db:generate, db:migrate, db:seed, db:seed:demo, db:reset.
test_framework: Vitest — run with `pnpm vitest run` for all tests or `pnpm vitest run src/lib` for specific module. Configuration in vitest.config.ts at project root.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `pnpm vitest run` — all tests must pass. 2. Run `pnpm build` — must complete with zero errors. 3. Run `pnpm lint` — no lint errors. For DB work: `pnpm db:generate` then `pnpm db:migrate` must succeed.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/db/migrations/ — generated by `pnpm db:generate` (drizzle-kit). These must be committed. Do not edit migration files manually.
environment_constraints: No actual Neon DB is provisioned — .env.example must be created and developer instructed to fill DATABASE_URL from Neon dashboard. For tests that touch DB logic, use mock/stub approach or in-memory. Never deploy to Vercel for real — only verify config is correct. Safe-area and mobile-first at 360px viewport width.
contribution_requirements: 1. All money logic uses integer rupiah — no floats, no hardcoded rates in code. 2. All API responses: { data, meta: { pagination }, message } for success; { message, errors } for errors. 3. All queries scoped by grup_id. 4. Mobile-first 360px, no horizontal scroll. 5. Minimum 44px touch targets. 6. Any calculation task must have passing Vitest unit tests.
key_patterns: 1. API routes at src/app/api/v1/[resource]/route.ts. 2. DB schema at src/db/schema/ — one file per domain. 3. Business logic at src/features/[domain]/ — pure functions separate from DB. 4. Shared utilities at src/lib/ (money, date, response helpers, query helpers). 5. UI components at src/components/ — domain-grouped. 6. Zod schemas for all API input validation — return 422 on validation error. 7. Auth: httpOnly cookie session, middleware.ts protects all non-public routes. 8. Drizzle: use drizzle-orm with @neondatabase/serverless driver.
directory_structure: src/app/ — Next.js App Router pages and API routes; src/app/(protected)/ — auth-gated pages; src/app/api/v1/ — versioned API routes; src/db/ — Drizzle schema and migrations; src/lib/ — shared utilities; src/features/ — domain business logic (pure functions); src/components/ — React UI components; src/components/ui/ — base design system components; public/ — static assets including PWA icons.
